title: Rosalind and the Veil
author: Ulyana Voss
blurb: Juniper Ravensworth, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
